data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 15.0m (2018: favourable development of GBP 3.5m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 13.6m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.6m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims development (from the published gross claims development table) shows a net adverse movement of approximately GBP 30.5m across underwriting years 2011-2017 (gross strengthening). The Managing Agent's movement note reports a net favourable development of GBP 15.0m after reinsurance recoveries, driven by releases primarily in Third Party Liability and reinsurance business. Thus, gross movements were adverse overall, but reinsurance recoveries produced a net reported favourable development in the financial statements.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development sourced from the gross claims development triangle (pages 36). The movement note (page 22) reports a NET favourable development of GBP 15.0m (after reinsurance recoveries) and gives LOB-level releases; that net figure was not a gross movement. Therefore the gross PYD used here is derived from the triangle while the report's narrative/net figure differs due to reinsurance. Triangle and movement-note numbers are in GBP '000 in the report and have been converted to millions.
